title: 第1章 空间灵根废柴第2章 修炼天才韩盈盈
lines: “咔嚓……咔嚓……”
两声石头碎裂的声音后，李卓阳低头看了下左右手中的两团灵石残渣，不由地苦笑着摇了摇头。
最后两块灵石了，还是无法突破到炼气四层！
难道黄级下品灵根，修炼就真的这么难吗？
他坐在蒲团上，内心久久不能平静。
李卓阳乃闽国紫阳郡最大的宗门紫阳门的外门弟子，目前已经困在炼气境三层两年了，始终无法突破。
五年前，他灵根觉醒时，还一度引起了全郡甚至全闽国的轰动，因为他的灵根属性居然是万年才出一个的空间属性。
然而等到测试出灵根等级时，李卓阳又变成了全国最大的笑话，因为他居然是黄级下品等级！
在这个世界上，灵根有多种属性，常见的有金木水火土五行属性灵根，较为罕见的有冰、风、雷电等属性，极为罕见的则仅有两种，时间属性和空间属性。
时间属性和空间属性堪称是所有灵根之祖，只要有这二者属性，修炼其他所有属性的功法，都无任何干扰，而且还能修炼专属的空间或时间法术。
可以说，这两个属性的修士，都是同阶无敌的存在，甚至越阶杀人也是常有之事。
然而修士的灵根除了属性外，还根据灵根的品质，分为天地玄黄四个品级。
品级不同，修炼的高度就不同，按照修仙界的共识，黄级品质的灵根，最多可修炼到炼气境大圆满，筑基极为艰难。
而黄级下品品级，想修炼到炼气境四层就要烧高香了。
李卓阳这个万年难遇的稀有灵根，偏偏只是个黄级下品的品级，这让当时紫阳门的众多长老都摇着头离开了。
不过却有两人坚称李卓阳一定可以修炼成功，其中一人便是他的祖父，李高峰。
李高峰是客居宗门的一位老人，看起来只有炼气境九层的修为，但是没人知道他的真实修为是多少，因为曾有人亲眼见到一个金丹境的修士朝其行参拜大礼。
可惜，祖父在三年前旧伤复发，撒手人寰，仅留给了李卓阳一间杂货铺。
“砰砰砰！开门！快快开门！”
忽如其来的拍门声，将李卓阳的调息打乱，幸好这两颗灵石已经吸收完毕，此时正在收尾，否则因为这敲门声走火入魔也未尝可知。
李卓阳连忙稳住呼吸，又用了片刻压下紊乱的气息，心中大怒地打开了门！
“是谁在打扰我修炼！”李卓阳怒道。
“呵！修炼？就你这资质，炼气三层已经到了头了，还修炼啥？”来人毫不客气的讥讽道。
此人名叫田持弓，是紫阳门的一名内门弟子，仗着其叔父是外门长老，经常跑到外门横行霸道。
李卓阳见是田持弓，眉头拧得更紧了。
“你来干什么？”
“李卓阳，你这店铺这月的管理费，赶紧给我交了！”
“店铺是宗门奖励给我父母的，你有何资格来收取管理费？”
李卓阳并非生来就与李高峰相依为命，他父亲李栋基是李高峰来紫阳郡后收养的一名孤儿。
李栋基修炼天赋极好，不到三十岁就筑基成功，娶了同为紫阳门内门弟子的师妹为道侣，并生下了李卓阳。
content_en:
"Click... click..."
After two sounds of stones breaking, Li Zhuoyang looked down at the two groups of spirit stone residues in his left and right hands, and shook his head with a wry smile.
It’s the last two spiritual stones, but I still can’t break through to the fourth level of Qi Refining!
Is it really that difficult to cultivate a low-grade Huang-level spiritual root?
He sat on the futon and couldn't calm down for a long time.
Li Zhuoyang is an outer disciple of Ziyang Sect, the largest sect in Ziyang County, Fujian Province. He has been trapped in the third level of Qi Refining Realm for two years and has been unable to break through.
Five years ago, when his spiritual root awakened, it caused a sensation in the whole county and even the whole country of Fujian, because the attribute of his spiritual root was actually a spatial attribute that only appeared once every ten thousand years.
However, when the spiritual root level was tested, Li Zhuoyang became the biggest joke in the country, because he was actually a low-level yellow level!
In this world, spiritual roots have many attributes. The common spiritual roots are the five elements of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth. The more rare ones have the attributes of ice, wind, thunder, and lightning. The extremely rare ones only have two attributes, the time attribute and the space attribute.
Time attributes and space attributes can be called the ancestors of all spiritual roots. As long as you have these two attributes, you can practice all other attributes without any interference, and you can also practice exclusive space or time spells.
It can be said that monks with these two attributes are invincible at the same level, and even killing people across levels is common.
However, in addition to attributes, a monk's spiritual root is also divided into four grades, heaven, earth, black and yellow, based on the quality of the spiritual root.
Different grades lead to different heights of cultivation. According to the consensus in the world of immortal cultivation, a yellow-grade spiritual root can be cultivated up to the Qi Refining Realm of Great Perfection, and foundation building is extremely difficult.
As for the low-level Huang level, if you want to reach the fourth level of Qi Refining Realm, you have to burn high incense.
Li Zhuoyang, a rare spiritual root that could only be found in ten thousand years, was only a low-grade yellow-level person. This made many elders of the Ziyang Sect shake their heads and leave.
However, two people insisted that Li Zhuoyang could succeed in cultivation, and one of them was his grandfather, Li Gaofeng.
Li Gaofeng was an old man living in the sect. He seemed to be at the ninth level of the Qi Refining Realm, but no one knew what his real cultivation level was because someone once saw a Golden Core Realm monk paying homage to him.
Unfortunately, his grandfather relapsed from an old injury three years ago and passed away, leaving only a grocery store to Li Zhuoyang.
"Bang bang bang! Open the door! Open the door quickly!"
The sudden knock on the door disrupted Li Zhuoyang's breath control. Fortunately, the two spirit stones had been absorbed and were finishing the work at this time, otherwise he would have gone crazy due to the knock on the door.
Li Zhuoyang quickly stabilized his breathing, took a moment to suppress his chaotic breath, and opened the door angrily!
"Who is disturbing my practice!" Li Zhuoyang said angrily.
"Ha! Cultivation? With your qualifications, you have already reached the end of the third level of Qi refining. Why do you still practice?" The person who came here sneered unceremoniously.
This person's name is Tian Chi Gong, an inner disciple of the Ziyang Sect. Because his uncle is an elder of the outer sect, he often goes to the outer sect and acts tyrannically.
Li Zhuoyang frowned even more when he saw that it was Tian holding a bow.
"What are you here for?"
"Li Zhuoyang, please pay me the management fee of your store this month!"
"The store was awarded to my parents by the sect. What qualifications do you have to charge management fees?"
Li Zhuoyang was not born to be dependent on Li Gaofeng. His father Li Dongji was an orphan adopted by Li Gaofeng after he came to Ziyang County.
Li Dongji was extremely talented in cultivation, and he succeeded in building the foundation before he was thirty years old. He married his junior sister who was also a disciple of the Ziyang Sect as a Taoist companion, and gave birth to Li Zhuoyang.
